bounded_original_repairs.heading: Model SQL authorization
bounded_original_repairs.text: Use a disposable database, dbo.StudyOrders table and StudyReader database user WITHOUT LOGIN, with no broad grants. Grant only SELECT on that table. Under authorized impersonation compare SELECT (expected allowed) with UPDATE (expected denied), then REVERT. This tests database authorization, not Entra sign-in or private endpoint connectivity. In SSMS inspect database Security > Users > StudyReader > Securables, explicit grants and role memberships; script the approved one-table change and test the denied action using the restricted identity.
bounded_original_repairs.question: Does a successful impersonated SELECT prove actual Entra sign-in?
bounded_original_repairs.answer: No; endpoint, TLS, token, principal mapping and actual-client authentication remain separate tests.
bounded_original_repairs.execution: Original teaching proposal; no product, SDK, engine or tenant execution. Expected outcomes are reasoning/arithmetic, not observed product results.

bounded_original_repairs.heading: Query and analyze with the right language
bounded_original_repairs.text: Root's shared synthetic fixture is suitable: East(2*10,Posted), East(3*10,Draft), West(4*5,Posted), West(1*10,Posted). Derive Revenue=Quantity*UnitPrice, retain originals, filter Posted and group by Region. Expected East=20 and West=30. In Power Query add typed Revenue and merge a unique RegionOwner lookup; verify unmatched keys and row counts. In the visual editor select Region/Revenue/Status, filter Posted, group by Region/sum Revenue and inspect View SQL. Keep store/model freshness and permission paths separate even when arithmetic matches.
bounded_original_repairs.question: Why can adding a duplicate lookup row change totals?
bounded_original_repairs.answer: A nonunique merge can multiply fact rows before grouping; reconcile cardinality and grain, not just fluent chart labels.
bounded_original_repairs.execution: Original teaching proposal; no product, SDK, engine or tenant execution. Expected outcomes are reasoning/arithmetic, not observed product results.

bounded_original_repairs.heading: Select the transformation engine / Windows and late events
bounded_original_repairs.text: Reuse the posted-order fixture above in SQL/PySpark/KQL: project fields, derive Revenue, filter Posted, group at Region grain; expect East20/West30. For events at12:01(value2),12:04(value3),12:06(value7), five-minute event-time bins yield12:00=5 and12:05=7. A late12:04 event can change a batch KQL requery over persisted events; a live streaming path follows its own watermark/lateness and emission contract. bin alone is not a watermark or proof that a downstream emitted result was corrected.
bounded_original_repairs.example:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
result = (sales.select('Region', 'Status', 'Quantity', 'UnitPrice')
 .withColumn('Revenue', F.col('Quantity') * F.col('UnitPrice'))
 .filter(F.col('Status') == 'Posted')
 .groupBy('Region').agg(F.sum('Revenue').alias('Total')))

// Existing typed synthetic Events table
Events | summarize Total = sum(Value) by WindowStart = bin(EventTime, 5m)
bounded_original_repairs.question: Does bin(EventTime,5m) guarantee every late event repairs the dashboard?
bounded_original_repairs.answer: No. Ingestion, retention, stream emission, lateness policy and consumer refresh/state have separate contracts.

bounded_original_repairs.heading: Choose the experience and the execution contract
bounded_original_repairs.text: Define an order-review generative page's reusable input/output contract: record ID and allowed view in, selected order and proposed action out. Record data bindings, accessible states, solution dependencies and upgrade tests. Generated React remains reviewed application code; do not imply it is a canvas component-library item. Custom APIs retain signed-in-user security and current connector/custom-API/Application-Insights capabilities have preview boundaries. Compare Power Automate cloud flow and Copilot Studio standard-harness agent flow using trigger, typed input/output, connection identity, error/retry/idempotency and solution lifecycle. Agent-flow actions can call prompts or agents; deterministic flow structure does not make generated text deterministic.
bounded_original_repairs.question: Where must exact maximum approved discount be enforced?
bounded_original_repairs.answer: In an authorized deterministic server operation; page displays, agent proposes and workflow routes validation/approval.

bounded_original_repairs.heading: Connect agents through the correct protocol and identity
bounded_original_repairs.text: Design an ORIGINAL custom-server tool propose_case_update: require caseId, expectedVersion and proposedStatus; reject extra fields; return proposalId,currentVersion,validationErrors,requiresApproval. These teaching names are not built-in Dataverse tool names or provider wire syntax. Bind authenticated tenant/caller server-side. A read-only caller's mutation is denied without writing; stale expectedVersion produces conflict. A separate idempotent commit validates approval and current state. For custom-agent to published Studio-agent handoff, carry bounded question, approved facts, correlation/conversation IDs, timeout and structured proposal validation. Confirm standard harness, tenant/environment, audience and caller grants. Do not translate that logical message directly into undocumented SDK calls.
bounded_original_repairs.question: Does discovery of update_record authorize every caller to change every case?
bounded_original_repairs.answer: No. Downstream authorization,current-state validation and approval remain separate. Current Dataverse MCP search_data searches data, search searches metadata, and describe replaces old discovery tools.

bounded_original_repairs.heading: Build and promote a code app
bounded_original_repairs.text: Design a supported resource alert in a managed test environment: product/type, environment/resource scope, metric, operator, justified threshold,severity, owned recipients and linked runbook. Correlate triggered resource with flow runs or Application Insights request IDs. Current Monitor rules use24-hour aggregate metrics and evaluate when new aggregates appear; creation performs on-demand evaluation. Treat rule state,email delivery and incident response as separate evidence. Use an appropriate faster telemetry detector for real-time exception response.
bounded_original_repairs.question: An exception happened one minute ago and no Monitor alert fired. Is the rule broken?
bounded_original_repairs.answer: Not established. Check aggregation/evaluation schedule, metric,scope,threshold and notification; this detector may be too slow for the SLO.

bounded_original_repairs.heading: Extend APIs without losing execution limits
bounded_original_repairs.text: Implement the same bounded operation contract using .NET and Python adapters: authenticate least-privileged app; read known account's ID/name/version; retrieve a filtered page and follow continuation; attempt update under reader identity and expect denial. Record exact SDK version,audience,principal,projection,result version and error category. Compare empty pages,403,429/Retry-After and stale-version handling. Use installed-version documented methods; do not invent Python methods by analogy with Organization service. Account for each SDK's own retries before adding an outer loop; bulk method does not guarantee universal atomicity.
bounded_original_repairs.question: Automatic SDK retries make blind outer retries safe?
bounded_original_repairs.answer: No. Classify failure, bound total attempts/time and make uncertain writes idempotent or reconcile them.

bounded_original_repairs.heading: Manage identities, collaboration objects, and licenses as lifecycles
bounded_original_repairs.text: Compare a bounded Microsoft Entra PowerShell user inventory with the existing Graph inventory by immutable object ID. Verify tenant context,consent,module version,properties,pagination and time window. Get-EntraUser -Top3 is a sample; -All requests the collection. Neither proves licensing or workload provisioning. Retain partial failures and compare IDs rather than row order/display names.

Get-EntraUser -Top 3 | Select-Object Id, DisplayName, UserPrincipalName

bounded_original_repairs.answer: No. Compare full intended ID set, per-object results and downstream state; a sample does not establish population completion.

bounded_original_repairs.heading: Tenant foundation, domains, licenses, and operational health
bounded_original_repairs.text: Treat suite and sign-in branding separately. Microsoft365 organization themes control suite navigation logo, alternate dark-theme logo,on-click company URL and colors under default/group scope. Entra branding controls sign-in background image/color,banner/header logo and layout with its own role/license prerequisites. A suite-logo company URL is not a clickable sign-in footer link. Build evidence table for asset,HTTPS source,target surface,audience,light/dark contrast,language/device and rollback; test a member and nonmember of group theme plus a fresh sign-in.
bounded_original_repairs.question: Suite logo is right but sign-in background unchanged. Did the suite theme fail?
bounded_original_repairs.answer: Not necessarily. Different settings control those surfaces; inspect intended audience/effective configuration at the owning plane.

proposals.proposed_markdown:
### Worked example — explicit competitor data changes the research route

**Confirmed — VERIFY CURRENT (October 28, 2026).** A synthetic opportunity explicitly identifies competitor North. The current [knowledge-source procedure](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/sales/configure-sqa-knowledge-source) gives that record-level competitor priority; a broader configured competitor list does not mean every listed competitor is researched. Remove the explicit competitor only in a test copy and compare the history/web-based route. Inspect source records, close descriptions and the selected competitors before treating a win-rate insight as representative of the whole market.
proposals.lab_update: Extend the opportunity-research lab with explicit-competitor versus blank-competitor copies. Record selected competitors, supporting closed records and any missing history. Keep custom-field research optional/tabletop while the same-page contradiction remains unresolved.
proposals.readiness_update: Why can two otherwise similar opportunities produce different competitor research? Record-level competitor data can select a different route; compare inputs before blaming the model.

proposals.proposed_markdown: **Confirmed — VERIFY CURRENT (October 28, 2026).** The [Power Platform connector-usage view](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/admin/manage/manage-tools-for-agent?view=o365-worldwide) is a **preview inventory view**: it identifies agents using a connector but does not manage connector policy. ### Build code apps against explicit data contracts

**Confirmed — VERIFY CURRENT (October 28, 2026).** A code app uses a web framework and the Power Apps client library; it is a complete app experience rather than a PCF control embedded in an existing host. Adding a [Dataverse data source](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/code-apps/how-to/connect-to-dataverse) generates TypeScript models and services. Inspect table metadata and generated types, select only needed columns, page deliberately, and send only changed fields on update. Current client limitations include metadata CRUD, FetchXML, alternate keys and polymorphic lookups; capabilities in another Dataverse SDK do not prove support here.

For [Dataverse actions/functions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/code-apps/how-to/add-dataverse-action-function), current instructions require `@microsoft/power-apps` 1.1.1+ and use `pa app find-dataverse-api` then `pa app add dataverse-api`. Discovery produces schemas and a generated service; it does not grant operation privileges. A bound operation also needs the target record ID. Regenerate after a contract change and inspect the diff before deploying.

### Move configuration and code together

Use [solution environment variables](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/code-apps/how-to/use-environment-variables) for supported dataset/table values. The current CLI accepts `@envvar:<schema-name>` references and retains them in `power.config.json`; resolve the target environment's values during promotion rather than copying development URLs. A connection still needs to exist and be authorized. Do not confuse solution configuration with process variables that configure the CLI.

Current [code-app ALM](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/code-apps/how-to/alm) uses `pa app push`. An explicit solution target is a GUID; without Dataverse, the app can publish without a solution. A subsequent push without a solution ID does not move existing solution membership. Choose the solution deliberately, use supported pipelines for promotion, and retain conventional source control because built-in source-code integration is currently unsupported. **VERIFY CURRENT:** CLI names, source integration and deployment behavior.

proposals.proposed_markdown:
### Diagnose the browser and telemetry boundaries

**Confirmed — VERIFY CURRENT (October 28, 2026).** [Code-app CSP](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/code-apps/how-to/content-security-policy) applies at environment scope. Its current default `connect-src` is `'none'`; only permit required endpoints and pilot changes with reporting. A custom source normally augments a directive, whereas a `'none'` default is replaced. Updating the complete directive collection can replace earlier settings; retrieve and review it before writing. An empty source array disables that directive instead of meaning deny-all.

[Application Insights integration](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/code-apps/how-to/set-up-azure-app-insights) captures session/network metrics only after the app loads. Startup or blocked-file failures require Power Platform Monitor and browser evidence. Configure the logger once, check required CSP endpoints and exclude sensitive payloads. The telemetry article's environment-variable limitation concerns instrumentation configuration; the supported data-source environment-variable route above does not establish a general runtime settings API.
proposals.lab_update: Tabletop a blocked startup asset versus a loaded app whose telemetry endpoint is blocked. Identify which tool can observe each failure, expected evidence and the narrow CSP change. Compare selected columns, repeated requests and timings under the affected user's role.

The [Python SDK](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/data-platform/sdk-python/overview) supports Azure Identity-compatible credentials, CRUD, paging, bulk operations and table/column metadata operations. Its simple SQL query surface is **read-only SELECT**, not a general SQL write channel. Distinguish multiple native bulk operations from a batch containing an explicitly transactional changeset; do not infer one universal all-or-nothing guarantee. Record package version, effective identity, table support, retry behavior and per-operation results. **VERIFY CURRENT:** supported operations and library contracts.

proposals.objective: Asynchronous logic by using background operations
proposals.proposed_markdown:
### Background processing changes connection lifetime

**Confirmed — VERIFY CURRENT; preview (October 28, 2026).** [Dataverse background operations](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/data-platform/background-operations) execute a custom API asynchronously, allowing the client connection to return. They retain the **two-minute plug-in execution limit**. The caller needs read/write privileges on the background-operations table. A Web API request using `Prefer: respond-async` returns an operation ID and status URL; that status resource differs from the OData table URL.

Poll conservatively or use the supported completion notification. A cancel request prevents work that has not started; it does not interrupt an already running operation. The documented retry policy can replay failures, so external effects still require idempotency. Select an external worker/Azure Function when execution itself exceeds the platform limit.
proposals.lab_update: Model queued, running and completed cancel requests and a transient failure after an external effect. State which work can continue, which identifiers correlate it and how duplicate effects are prevented.
proposals.readiness_update: Does respond-async make a five-minute synchronous custom API valid? No; it releases the client connection without extending plug-in execution time.

For a code app, the [Copilot Studio connector procedure](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/code-apps/how-to/connect-to-copilot-studio) creates/selects a connection, adds it as a data source, generates a service and calls a **published** agent by its exact name. `ExecuteCopilotAsyncV2` waits for responses despite its name; the older `ExecuteCopilot` returns a conversation ID without the answer. Inspect completion and response fields rather than equating receipt of an ID with task success.

For a custom web/native application or another code-first agent, the [Copilot Studio client library](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/agents-sdk/integrate-with-mcs) has .NET, JavaScript and Python samples. Current support is for the **standard harness**, not the GitHub Copilot harness. **VERIFY CURRENT:** connector actions, client/harness support and generated contracts.

### Integrate custom agents through governed tools

A code-first Foundry agent needs a model, instructions and explicit tool configuration, plus an application-level loop that handles tool output, errors and approval. Choose shared workload access only when every caller should receive the same data scope. [Foundry MCP authentication](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/mcp-authentication) distinguishes shared credentials/identities, incoming-user delegation and per-user OAuth consent; one method's support does not establish another's. Treat project connection creation, OAuth consent and approval of a proposed tool call as separate states.

The [developer MCP guide](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-agent-365/add-mcp-tools-developer-experiences) also separates consuming a governed server, building one from connectors/Dataverse custom APIs, and registering a BYO server for administrative review. For consumption, inspect the allow-listed tools and invoke the smallest authorized operation. Registration alone does not prove tenant consent, supported client routing, Dataverse authorization or successful invocation. **VERIFY CURRENT:** endpoint, host, identity, scope, preview and rollout support.

Current defaults exclude nonproduction environments and have regional/government exceptions; do not assume a developer environment matches a production rollout. A table shared through another enabled app can remain available after one app is disabled.

This business-app integration does **not** establish support through every Work IQ tool. The current [generic MCP retrieve reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/extensibility/work-iq/mcp/retrieve) explicitly excludes Dataverse and Power BI, even though a Dataverse capability name appears in the schema. Treat that path as unavailable until the reference changes.

The separately documented [Dataverse Ask APIs](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/data-platform/ask/?bc=/power-platform/breadcrumb/TOC.json&toc=/power-platform/business-applications-work-iq/toc.json) accept natural-language questions against a semantic model and can return structured rows plus a summary. Their `/api/iq/v1.0/` route is not the OData `/api/data/` service and does not support OData options or dedicated .NET/Python SDK client classes. Use HTTP with the correct Dataverse token, and use the Web API for precise CRUD.
proposals.lab_update: Make a matrix for Business Applications settings, a model-scoped Ask request, generic Work IQ retrieve and exact Web API CRUD. Record each endpoint, supported inputs, identity, data scope and availability. A generated schema name is not a successful integration test.
